content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fayetteville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria on their website to verify your background meets the education and experience thresholds before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend all sessions synchronously from Fayetteville on your schedule. Our certified instructors deliver the full curriculum in real time, ensuring you master the PMBOK® Guide framework and exam domains required by PMI.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, apply directly to PMI with proof of education and work experience. Pay PMI's exam fee and await approval of your application. Granite PM Academy will provide guidance on the submission process and documentation you'll need.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources, including practice tests and review sessions, to build confidence in the four domains of the PMP. Schedule your exam with Pearson VUE and sit for the four-hour, 180-question test in your preferred format and location.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Upon passing, you earn the PMP designation. Maintain it by earning professional development units (PDUs) across PMI's standard three-year renewal cycle. Stay current with continuing education and renew your credential before expiration to keep your competitive edge in Fayetteville's job market.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
